concept.title: The Date That Missed Its Reservation
concept.human_truth: Mature love does not remove childish irritation; it learns the feeling beneath it and still finds a way back to play.
concept.emotional_arc: playful departure -> small irritation -> respectful pause -> disappointment understood -> accidental roadside date -> affectionate callback

slides.copy:
This is the kind of love
I want us to grow into.
slides.visual: Rain-damp evening at a tiny roadside chai stall. Exactly Aachu and Zuv sit on two plastic stools pulled close, dressed for a proper date but slightly rumpled, sharing a private laugh over two small glasses of chai. Their scooter is parked safely on the quieter opposite shoulder to avoid traffic. Across the divided road, through a stream of cars, the intended restaurant on the next road is visibly close but inconvenient to reach. The frame feels like the warm aftermath of a story, not a posed portrait. No chai vendor or background people visible.
slides.props: two chai glasses, one biscuit packet, two helmets, one parked scooter, distant restaurant frontage across divided road
slides.continuity_lock: Same date-night wardrobe and the same scooter, helmets, and rainy evening continue through slides 2-7. Exactly two visible people in every frame.

slides.copy:
The date began with one missing key
and two suspects.
slides.visual: Inside their entryway before leaving, Aachu holds both scooter helmets and points a playful accusing finger while Zuv checks his jacket pockets and looks theatrically innocent. The scooter key is visibly caught in the tote strap between them. Exactly two people; the physical evidence makes the joke readable without text.
slides.props: two helmets, scooter key, tote bag
slides.continuity_lock: Same date-night wardrobe and scooter accessories as slide 1.

slides.copy:
By the third wrong turn,
nobody was cute anymore.
slides.visual: They stand beside their parked scooter on the quieter side of a rain-slick divided road. A phone map in Zuv's hand reroutes while the intended restaurant is frustratingly visible across the traffic on the next road. Aachu holds both helmets and looks away, tired and irritated; Zuv studies the route with restrained frustration. Exactly two visible people and no reflections.
slides.emotion: comic frustration tipping into real irritation
slides.props: parked scooter, two helmets, phone map without legible UI text, traffic divider, distant restaurant frontage
slides.continuity_lock: Same scooter, route, wardrobe, weather, and evening.

slides.copy:
“Don’t talk to me.”

He gave her the minute.
Not the distance.
slides.visual: At a safe recessed roadside edge near the parked scooter, Aachu faces slightly away with arms folded. Zuv stays beside the scooter several feet behind her, body open and grounded, not reaching or crowding. His helmet rests securely against his hip; her helmet hangs from one relaxed hand. The empty space between them communicates a respected pause while his remaining nearby communicates care. Exactly two people.
slides.continuity_lock: Same road, weather, wardrobe, scooter, and helmets.

slides.copy:
It wasn’t really the wrong turn.

They had simply missed each other
for too many ordinary days.
slides.visual: Across the road outside the intended restaurant, the frontage is closed or inaccessible after the long detour. Aachu's irritation has fallen into quiet disappointment as she looks at the dark entrance. Zuv notices her expression rather than the shutter, holding the phone down at his side. Their body distance has narrowed but they do not yet touch. Exactly two people, no background diners or staff.
slides.props: dark restaurant frontage, phone held down, helmets, rain traces
slides.continuity_lock: Same evening, wardrobe, scooter route, and date.

slides.copy:
The plan failed.
The date didn’t.
slides.visual: At the tiny roadside chai stall beside their safely parked scooter, Aachu steals a sip from Zuv's chai after finishing hers. Zuv gives her a mock-offended look while protecting the biscuit packet against his chest. Two stools are now pulled close. The unreachable restaurant glows softly across the divided road behind traffic. Exactly two people, vendor out of frame.
slides.props: two chai glasses, biscuit packet, two close stools, parked scooter, two helmets, distant restaurant
slides.continuity_lock: Exact return to the cover location and same wardrobe.

slides.copy:
He still checked the lock twice.
She still rolled her eyes.

Then she went back
and checked it with him.
slides.visual: Back home after the date, Zuv has stepped away from the locked door but glances back. Aachu rolls her eyes, returns to the handle, and tests it herself; he catches her doing it and smiles. Their helmets and damp outer layers sit nearby as proof of the evening. Exactly two people and one clear door handle action.
slides.props: door handle, two helmets, damp outer layers, scooter key
slides.continuity_lock: Same date-night wardrobe and accessories; the night ends where it began.

copy.caption_recommended: May we grow into the kind of love that gives each other a minute, not a distance—and still knows when the proper date can become two glasses of roadside chai.
copy.caption_alt: The plan failed. The date didn’t.
